description: This file implements the Controller class for managing IPC clients within the Rialto server manager. It provides methods to create, remove, and perform actions on clients, such as setting state, configuration, ping, and log levels.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages IPC clients, providing thread-safe methods to create, remove, and perform actions on clients.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Controller with a session server app manager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client connection if one does not already exist for the given server ID.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sets the session server state for the specified client.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the specified client with initial state, socket name, display name, resource limits, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Sends a ping to the specified client.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for all clients.
